entities.summary: Alexander Blockx is a Belgian professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 88 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 467 reached on 10 November 2025. He is currently the No. 3 singles player from Belgium.
